# Isometric

Measured spatial depth, translated into a practical interface.

## Use

Use for systems explanations, process overviews, and spatial product demonstrations.

## Essential traits

- Extruded layers
- Diagonal structural accents
- Readable front-facing content

## Typography

System sans-serif with structured headings.

## Layout and surfaces

Layered planes, offset rails, and a clear spatial hierarchy. Subtle extruded edges and isometric background tiles; live text remains front-facing.

## Palette

- background: #e8eff5
- surface: #ffffff
- text: #19384d
- muted: #4c6476
- accent: #235d80
- border: #b4c8d5

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Isometric to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. System sans-serif with structured headings. Layered planes, offset rails, and a clear spatial hierarchy. Subtle extruded edges and isometric background tiles; live text remains front-facing. Palette: background #e8eff5, surface #ffffff, text #19384d, muted #4c6476, accent #235d80, border #b4c8d5. Essential traits: Extruded layers; Diagonal structural accents; Readable front-facing content. Avoid: Skewed body text; Ambiguous depth order; Perspective that impairs controls. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
